frase_gancho.texto: To finish, a wall of skulls beneath the street and a look at what joins the Cathedral and the Templo Mayor.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: Two final stops, now outside the museum. The first is one street away, on Guatemala Street: the Huei Tzompantli, the great wall of skulls that came to light in 2015 beneath a colonial building. The second is the plaza, where the Cathedral and the Templo Mayor stand just a few meters apart, one on top of the other in time: the Mexica temple was torn down and its stone was used for the viceregal building. This last stop brings the two worlds together and leaves you with a question for the rest of the Historic Center.
